claims.exactBehavior: Frame-owned, transient, separate deduplicated addition/removal recency lists populate the actual searching submenus newest first. Typed stable commands toggle the selected historical predicate on the currently visible media page, retire its entry before recording the resulting delta, and leave stale commands inert. New/restored page predicates do not enter history; histories survive page close/restore, apply across pages and stay independent across windows. Committed typed OR is one entry; cancelled predicate children and refused inputs add none. Undo enters a locked page hidden query while retaining its lock; with an empty notebook selected, it preserves history. Clear history uses the exact reference confirmation: rejection retains both lists; acceptance clears both without changing searches or closed-page history. History names use raw predicate text despite hidden-namespace presentation. Populated locked pages retain their prior lock badge and media even with synchronization enabled; locking and hash synchronization update the cached panel count. Accepted system values preserve originating Shift intent: drafts extend without frame history; normal activation merges into one committed OR history entry. Accepting a system value and later cancelling its outer OR leaves frame history unchanged while retaining actual reference recent predicates.
